why: The control. Under D20 this scenario changed job completely: the query enumerates, so a clean machine no longer returns zero rows -- it returns its whole inventory. What must still be zero is the CLASSIFIER's output. `forbid` is the real assertion and it is what caught the stock Apple native-messaging manifest reporting two phantom findings on every Mac in the fleet. model stays a hard 0: no dotdir on a clean machine has a models/manifests tree, so a nonzero there is an over-broad glob.
